# FishDev Workflow

Install FishDev v0.5.0 from the root of a new project directory. These commands download the installer, check its SHA-256 digest, and run it only if the check passes.

Linux:

```bash
curl -fsSLo fishdev-install.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fishdan/fishdev/v0.5.0/install.sh && echo "c79a63ae7995be5dfc1f3560f47e2b7157fa59a5c64a75b714dfb068ec150b86  fishdev-install.sh" | sha256sum -c - && bash fishdev-install.sh && rm fishdev-install.sh
```

macOS:

```bash
curl -fsSLo fishdev-install.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fishdan/fishdev/v0.5.0/install.sh && echo "c79a63ae7995be5dfc1f3560f47e2b7157fa59a5c64a75b714dfb068ec150b86  fishdev-install.sh" | shasum -a 256 -c - && bash fishdev-install.sh && rm fishdev-install.sh
```

The installer then verifies every FishDev file, the uv installer, and the SpecKit wheel against digests pinned for this release. See [release integrity](docs/release-integrity.md) for what this protects against and its limits.

On Windows, follow the [VS Code and PowerShell setup guide](docs/windows-vscode-powershell.md).

## What is FishDev?

FishDev is a standardized, constitution-driven workflow for AI-assisted software development. It relies on [SpecKit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit) and a strict set of engineering principles to ensure that AI coding assistants behave predictably, maintain project history, and produce clean, testable code. 

When initialized, FishDev scaffolds an authoritative `.config/ai/` directory that stores your project's state, handoff notes, progress logs, and your engineering constitution. This enforces "Spec-First Development," meaning no code is written without a clear specification, keeping your project organized and fully transparent.

FishDev also provides a [project verification and learning workflow](docs/verification-and-learning.md). After initialization, configure `.config/ai/verification.json` for your stack, then run `python .config/ai/tools/fishdev.py verify`. The same command runs in CI. `check` enforces concrete architectural rules, while `retro` drafts proposals from repeated human corrections for review.

FishDev installs are pinned and verified: each release fixes the exact FishDev files, uv, and SpecKit it installs, and checks their SHA-256 digests before writing anything. See [release integrity](docs/release-integrity.md) for the threat model and the maintainer release procedure.

## Why AI Agnosticism Matters

The AI landscape is moving incredibly fast. Today's best coding assistant might be obsolete in six months, and development teams are often fractured across multiple tools (like Copilot, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or Aider). 

FishDev is built to be **strictly AI-vendor-neutral**. 

By storing all workflows, instructions, and context inside a standardized `.config/ai/` directory rather than proprietary vendor folders (like `.cursor/` or `.gemini/`), you guarantee that your project remains portable. Any engineer using any AI agent can drop into your repository, run the `start.ai` sequence, and immediately align with the project's constitution and active specifications. This eliminates vendor lock-in and ensures your repository's history and rules belong to *you*, not your tools.
